answer:
Obtain the starting structure from a structure-retrieval tool, using a standard experimental BiFeO3 R3c primitive cell with 10 atoms per cell.
If no structure-retrieval tool is available, do not guess a structure and report that the local inputs do not contain enough structure data to start the calculation.
Use the provided LDA pseudopotential files for Bi, Fe, and O.
Set ecutwfc to 80 Ry.
Set ecutrho to 4 times ecutwfc.
Use automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point sampling with a 6x6x6 grid and half-shift offsets of 0.5, 0.5, 0.5.
Do not set starting magnetization, Hubbard U, smearing, or spin-orbit-coupling flags; use Quantum ESPRESSO defaults for these controls.
Run a variable-cell relaxation with etot_conv_thr set to 1.0e-8, forc_conv_thr set to 1.0e-7, and conv_thr set to 1.0e-8.
After the variable-cell relaxation finishes, run a self-consistent field calculation on the relaxed structure with conv_thr set to 1.0e-8 and all other settings consistent with the relaxation calculation.
Report the fully relaxed structure in CIF format and the final self-consistent field total energy in Ry.
